element.name: Firebase Hosting
element.documentation: Firebase Hosting site (Spark plan) hosting the public/ frontend and the project's Firebase web config (/__/firebase/init.json).

element.name: Cloud Firestore
element.documentation: Cloud Firestore in the project â€” hosting the (default) database, its security rules and the Database Engine that executes its queries.

element.name: (default)
element.documentation: Spark-plan Firestore database (Standard edition). Holds demoItems, created and seeded by the Frontend on first visit.

element.name: Firebase Web Config
element.documentation: /__/firebase/init.json, served automatically by Firebase Hosting â€” projectId, apiKey and related settings read by the Frontend at runtime. Identifies the project; not a secret (firestore.rules is the access control).

element.name: Firestore Security Rules
element.documentation: firestore.rules â€” the only access control, since browsers reach Firestore directly: public reads of demoItems, creates of documents 1-3 only with the exact seed values, no updates or deletes, and nothing else.

element.name: Internet
element.documentation: The genuinely open internet: any browser, anywhere, can reach the Hosting site's public HTTPS endpoint and Firestore's public API endpoint (firestore.googleapis.com). This is the Visitor's ingress path and, with no server-side API, also the browser's path to the database; what it may do there is gated by Firestore Security Rules, not by the network.

element.name: Frontend
element.documentation: Static browser app (public/index.html, public/app.js). Loads the demo items on page load and renders the returned DemoItem rows; separately fetches the static /version.json (written by deploy.sh) to show a build version/timestamp in the footer.

element.name: Initialize Demo Data
element.documentation: First-use setup: creates the demo item store if it doesn't exist yet and inserts the three seed items if it is empty, guarded so concurrent first loads seed only once.

property.value: seedItems(): runTransaction, read demoItems/1-3, create each missing seed document

element.name: Read Demo Items
element.documentation: Reads all demo items ordered by Id, on every page load.

element.name: DemoItems
element.documentation: The stored demo items â€” created and seeded on first use by Initialize Demo Data (app-init-demo-data).

element.name: Firestore API Interface
element.documentation: Interface exposed by Cloud Firestore for external communication â€” firestore.googleapis.com, which the Firebase JS SDK (sys-firebase-js-sdk) uses from the browser to exchange queries and results.

element.name: Web App Interface
element.documentation: Interface exposed by the web hosting node for external communication.

element.name: Firestore Database Engine
element.documentation: Database engine behind Cloud Firestore â€” executes the queries app-init-demo-data/app-read-demo-items send through the Firestore API Interface, after checking the security rules.

element.name: Firebase Hosting Service
element.documentation: Firebase Hosting's own hosting service â€” serves the Frontend's static files to the browser, and serves the project's web config (Firebase Web Config) at /__/firebase/init.json.

element.name: Firebase JS SDK (v13)
element.documentation: Firebase JavaScript SDK (firebase-app and firebase-firestore 13.4.0), imported by public/app.js as ES modules from www.gstatic.com â€” the Firestore client library the Frontend uses from the Visitor's browser (see uml/structure/3-component.puml's "Firestore API" interface).

element.name: Visitor
element.documentation: End user browsing the deployed web app (8-use-case.puml).

element.name: View Demo Items
element.documentation: The Visitor loads the page and sees the demo item list (8-use-case.puml UC1, includes UC2 "Initialize demo data").

element.name: Website
element.documentation: The public URL/browser channel through which the Visitor reaches the app.

element.name: Demo Item
element.documentation: The business concept of an inventory item (Id, Name, Category) the Visitor views â€” the business-relevant counterpart of the stored demo items (do-demo-items).

element.name: Demo Items Table
element.documentation: The rendered <table id="items"> in public/index.html, populated by app.js's loadItems() â€” the perceptible form of Demo Item the Visitor actually reads.

element.name: Frontend Interface
element.documentation: HTTP interface exposed by the Frontend component for the Visitor to interact with.
